scientific.integrity: The proof reconstructs all line-bundle identifications from the initiating source and then uses only multiplicativity of relative Frobenius with cup product. The scheme-theoretic multiplicity statement follows locally from the exact equation that the degree-\(2i\) section is the \(i\)-th power of the degree-two section.
limitations: The divisor equality requires an integral base and a nonempty Frobenius-split locus.
No reducedness, irreducibility, smoothness, or local equation for the primitive degree-two divisor is asserted.
The argument is restricted to the Hodge-good locus where the even coherent cohomology sheaves are line bundles and cup powers are isomorphisms.

title: The top coherent Frobenius divisor is an \(n\)-fold thickening
